options.label: The Living Scriptorium Desk
options.thesis: A working author's workstation centered on a live interactive manuscript with dynamic @mention auto-linking and lore consistency sentinel in action.
options.viewport: Center manuscript scroll with live interactive typing demonstration linking entities, framed by active entity seals and immediate CTA.
options.risk: Requires rich interactive state in the hero rather than static marketing copy.

options.label: The Cathedral Archway & Omni-Search Portal
options.thesis: A monumental celestial portico framing a live working Command Palette (Ctrl+K) where visitors immediately search and query lore entities from the first viewport.
options.viewport: Grand Cinzel title over an embedded live search console summoning characters, factions, and spell rules with instant previews.
options.risk: Can feel like an app utility if the mythic ceremony is underplayed.

options.label: The Open Folio Spread
options.thesis: A two-page open sacred tome on celestial marble: left page visualizes the live interconnected lore graph; right page holds the sacred pact and creation CTA.
options.viewport: Dual-leaf tome opened across the screen with interactive nodes on the left and authorial decree on the right.
options.risk: Needs careful responsive adaptation on mobile screens.
